{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jesart desert''' was the location of [[Eliad]]'s only [[Eliad spaceport|spaceport]] and one of the many biome types that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was located in the southern hemisphere of the world, far from any [[Human/Legends|human]] settlement.
